heading: Fall in the Okanagan
title: Fall in the Okanagan: Things to Do | Okanagan Roam
description: Things to do in the Okanagan this fall: u-pick farms, cideries, winery restaurants, kokanee and waterfall walks, Halloween, events and cozy spots.
intro: Fall is harvest time in the Okanagan: orchards and farm stands, cider and wine, and meals at winery restaurants. It's also a good season for creek walks, the kokanee run, Halloween and a busy events calendar, with plenty of cozy places to warm up when the evenings cool down.
Here are our fall guides, all built from verified listings.

items.tip: {page:/guides/fall-farms-u-pick-okanagan|U-pick orchards, farm stands & farm visits} covers orchards, farm days out with animals, farm cafés and tastings among the trees.
{page:/guides/okanagan-cideries|Okanagan cideries for apple season} rounds up orchard cideries, cider with a proper meal and family-friendly tasting rooms.
{page:/guides/okanagan-winery-restaurants|Okanagan winery restaurants for fall} lists winery dining rooms by area, starting with the heated, covered and cozy ones.
{page:/guides/kokanee-salmon-okanagan|Where to see the kokanee salmon run} covers the creeks where the listings mention spawning kokanee, plus other salmon runs and fishing.
{page:/guides/okanagan-waterfall-walks|Okanagan waterfall walks} groups waterfall hikes from short and easy to full-day climbs.
{page:/guides/halloween-okanagan|Halloween in the Okanagan 2026} covers haunted mazes and trails, family events, Halloween at the wineries and nights out.
{page:/guides/fall-events-okanagan|Fall events & festivals, October–November 2026} picks the season's festivals, cider and beer events, harvest dinners and markets.
{page:/guides/okanagan-hockey-season|Hockey season in the Okanagan} lists home games for the valley's teams.
{page:/guides/cozy-spots-okanagan|Cozy spots for cool days} finds fireside dining rooms, fire pits and heated, blanketed patios.
{page:/guides/soup-ramen-pho-okanagan|Soup, ramen & pho} covers ramen, pho, borscht, chowder, curries and dumplings.
{page:/guides/rainy-day-okanagan|A rainy day in the Okanagan} covers museums, an indoor waterpark, floating saunas and shows.
{page:/guides/indoor-golf-okanagan|Indoor golf in the Okanagan} lists the valley's golf simulators, lessons and leagues.
